full_judgment: 10. Admittedly, Zakia Khanom filed Title Suit No.62 of 1996 challenging the order of her termination and ultimately obtained a decree in her favour with a comment "termination of the plaintiff from the post of teacher of General History in Dhaka Women College on 17-3-1996 is illegal, void, inoperative and not binding upon the respondent and she is still in service in that post with salary and other benefits permissible to her" and the said decree was upheld up to this Division.
